thread:
marta: Heads-up — onboarding sample crashes in Edge: `Cannot use import statement outside a module`. Works in Node but fails with wrangler dev.

zach: which package?

marta: js-sdk. Repro: clone sample, npm i, wrangler dev -> error from dist/index.cjs.

samir: is sample missing `type: module`?

marta: sample has `type: module`. Problem seems to be our conditional exports resolving to CJS under Wrangler.

elaine: paste exports block?

marta: "exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }

samir: CF Workers & some bundlers don't interpret import/require the same. They sometimes fall back to default or ignore `import`.

zach: options: add a `worker` condition, or publish an ESM-only `sdk-edge` package.

elaine: prefer not to publish extra package. Could add \"worker\": \"./dist/index.mjs\" in exports.

marta: tried that; helped some bundlers but Wrangler still picks CJS. Wrangler resolves `module`/`default`/`require` order oddly.

samir: we could add a tiny index.cjs shim that re-exports the ESM default: `module.exports = require('./index.mjs').default` — ugly but safe short-term.

zach: another approach: nested conditions: \"worker\": {\"import\":\"./dist/index.mjs\"}, \"default\": {\"import\":\"./dist/index.mjs\",\"require\":\"./dist/index.cjs\"} to prioritize worker-aware resolvers.

marta: typings also tricky. Some TS toolchains need `types` inside the exports map like \"types\": {\"default\": \"./dist/index.d.ts\"} — we should add that.

elaine: also: auth/retry parity. Edge build currently pulls node-only credential provider that requires fs. That's causing init crash. We need to separate providers into node vs edge so tree-shaking removes node-only code from the edge bundle.

samir: agreed. Action plan: prototype exports with `worker` condition + types mapping (small PR), add index.cjs shim for fast fix, split providers into providers/node and providers/edge.

marta: I'll add a wrangler smoke test in CI and an edge-quickstart sample that uses explicit ESM import and wrangler.toml. dev-ci-bot: ci/test-samples #437 queued.

zach: add publish gate: if wrangler smoke fails, block publish. Also prepare release notes for Dedicated customers for the package.json change.

elaine: tasks and owners:
- samir: PR for conditional exports + types mapping (EOD Tue)
- marta: wrangler smoke test + edge sample (Wed)
- elaine: draft release notes & customer impact (Thu)

samir: will push index.cjs shim in the meantime to avoid regressions. We'll remove shim in next major.

marta: will post PR links here. :thumbsup:

zach: ping me if anyone hits the issue before the fix; I can toggle CDN fallback to prefer ESM temporarily.

marta: closing loop for now.
summary: Thread discussing conditional exports causing Edge runtimes (Wrangler) to select CJS build; propose adding a worker conditional, types mapping, a temporary CJS shim, splitting auth providers for edge vs node, and adding wrangler smoke tests to CI to block bad publishes.
